note: First published schema of the nexus verify --json document (also the receipt --receipt writes), generated from VerifyJsonOutput in cli/src/verify_contract.ts on release/v1.3.0. Nothing was published before it: the document of the first nexus verify slice had no schema, and its typecheck and guard members (then always NOT_RUN) take their real shapes here.

Additive, schema_version stays 1 (nexus verify --sandbox, VR-1 slice 3). New optional members: sandbox (requested, engine, network) on the result and sandboxed on each entry of runs; this producer always writes both, and they are optional in the schema so that a document written before them still validates. One new value of the reason enumeration: SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE (verdict BLOCKED, exit 3), written only when --sandbox was requested; a document with it does not validate against the earlier schema text, whose enumeration is closed. No member was removed or renamed and none changed type or meaning; a consumer that ignores unknown members and treats an unknown reason as not VERIFIED is unaffected.

Bump schema_version because sandbox.requested now means the operator explicitly selected a sandbox; implicit default confinement is reflected by the effective engine and per-run sandboxed facts. This changes the field's meaning, so consumers must reject version 2 until they account for the distinction.

Bump schema_version: the review member changes meaning from 'not run in this version' (a VerifyIngredient with status NOT_RUN only) to a structured reviewer result when the independent reviewer read the evidence (status COMPLETE, ACCEPT/REJECT, verifiedObservations, suspectedDefects, unprovenCriteria, scopeViolations and reviewerConfidenceNote), with NOT_RUN retained when no head verifier ran. The published shape publishes only members this reviewer writes; internal IndependentReviewVerdict members such as boundaryReport, changeAssessment and a defect's optional line are not published. New reason REVIEW_REJECTED (BLOCKED, exit 3) lets a REJECT withhold VERIFIED; it never raises a lower verdict. Consumers that treated review as always NOT_RUN must reject version 3 until they read the new shape.

Add optional runs[].testFixtureReads for test-oracle files and candidate-only workspace paths observed more often than in the base run, including directory and metadata observations. Additive to the v3 review shape: the member is optional so older documents still validate, and consumers that ignore unknown members are unaffected; independent-verification consumers should treat its presence as a pass that is not independent.

Combine the independent-reviewer review shape (fc7c244) with optional runs[].testFixtureReads (7e976e86) and the clarified definitionBound description: a single checked-in v3 schema after merging those slices. Additive; schema_version stays 3. Consumers that ignore unknown members and already accept either prior v3 document are unaffected.

Additive, schema_version stays 3 (VR-3 sandbox denial receipts). New optional sandboxEvents member on the result: typed refusals with kind, engine, profile, operation, category, reason and at. Older documents omit it; no member was removed, renamed, or changed type or meaning. A denial is evidence only: it never raises a verdict and the engine-unavailable reason still maps to BLOCKED.
